# Test m1: cache accepts key_func
r = await world.call('repo.shell', command="python -c "
from funcy import cache

# Test with key_func
calls = []
@cache(timeout=60, key_func=lambda x: x)
def inc(x):
    calls.append(x)
    return x * 2

result = inc(5)
print('m1 result:', result)
assert result == 10, f'Expected 10, got {result}'
assert calls == [5], f'Expected [5], got {calls}'

# Second call should use cache
result2 = inc(5)
assert result2 == 10
assert calls == [5], f'Should have cached, expected [5], got {calls}'

# Test default behavior (no key_func)
calls2 = []
@cache(timeout=60)
def inc2(x):
    calls2.append(x)
    return x * 2

result3 = inc2(5)
assert result3 == 10
print('m1 PASSED')
"")
